subject: Novum Insights - Azure Private Plan procurement playbook
messages:
From: James Holloway <james.holloway@novuminsights.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Novum Insights Procurement <procurements@novuminsights.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Azure private plan — procurement kickoff

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the intro—Novum is excited to move forward with a private Azure offer for our analytics product. Procurement asked me to start a single thread to capture commercial and legal requirements so our contracts team can route the PO quickly. High-level asks from our side: 

- Architecture: private plan backed by a dedicated Azure listing, with entitlement mapping to our tenant.
- Billing: want seller-billed invoices, PO to our vendor portal (instructions attached).
- Security: SOC 2 attestation and DPA with explicit KMS support.
- Data residency: prefer US-East only.

Can you send your standard private plan terms, a sample invoice flow, and a rough mutual action plan with estimated time to sign? I attached our RFQ spreadsheet with expected seat/consumption bands.

Appreciate a quick turnaround—we have an internal finance cutover the week of 8/31.

Thanks,
James Holloway
Head of Procurement
Novum Insights
Attachment: Novum_AZ-RFQ.xlsx (xlsx)

From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
To: James Holloway <james.holloway@novuminsights.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan — procurement kickoff

Hi James—thanks for the clear RFQ. Looping in Laura (commercial ops) and Ben (billing) so we can align the Azure private plan and PO workflow.

Attached: Redwood_Azure_PrivatePlan_Terms_v1.pdf (PDF) — this contains: private plan commercial template, standard DPA cross-reference, SLA, and entitlement mapping guidance. Highlights up front:

- Seller-billed invoicing to customer PO is supported; we can route PDFs to your vendor portal (need portal endpoint/PO number format).
- Standard billing cadence: monthly in arrears, net 30. We can offer quarterly invoicing for enterprise contracts on request.
- SLA: standard 99.9% availability; enterprise SLA addendum available on dedicated capacity.
- KMS: support for customer-managed keys on Private when deployed in customer-managed subscription; will need KMS ARN and cert exchange.

Proposed next steps:
1) We review Novum RFQ and confirm pricing bands (we'll do this by EOD 8/20).
2) Legal teams exchange redlines — I can share our preferred DocuSign powerform for countersign.
3) Finalize PO routing and invoice sample.

Would you be available for a 30-min call on Friday 8/21 (10:00–10:30 PT)? If yes, I'll calendar invite.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior GTM, Marketplace & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Azure_PrivatePlan_Terms_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-20T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan — procurement kickoff

Aditya—quick internal note before the call with Novum. A few negotiation levers to prepare: 

- Invoice cadence: offer monthly net 30 as standard but be ready to accept monthly net 45 if Novum's PO process requires extra approvals (we can escalate for net 60 only with exec sign-off).
- Entitlements: ensure the offer includes per-tenant entitlement mapping and a usage reporting feed (daily CSV) — this avoids billing disputes.
- SLA credits: keep 99.9% but reserve migration credit language (one-time) for onboarding issues.
- Azure listing: confirm whether they need private plan + bring-your-own-publisher or a marketplace private offer that lists under Redwood. If they want co-sell revenue split, we need early visibility to engage marketplace GTM.

I'll add these to the redlines summary and prepare a short playbook for the call (roles: sales -> commercial ops -> legal -> billing).

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: James Holloway <james.holloway@novuminsights.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Novum Insights Procurement <procurements@novuminsights.com>, Novum Legal <legal@novuminsights.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan — procurement kickoff

Thanks Aditya/Laura—call works. Quick follow-ups from Legal: 

- We need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report and a completed security questionnaire (attached).
- DPA: can you confirm whether Redwood's standard DPA supports customer-managed keys and an explicit data residency clause (US only)? If not, Novum will propose language.
- Payment terms: Novum prefers monthly net 45 but can accept net 30 for the first 3 months as a trial.
- Marketplace routing: Novum would like the private offer to be listed under their tenant (Novum as publisher) so license entitlements map to their internal subscriptions. Is that supported?

Attached: Novum_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf) — legal will populate and send back.

Let us know where to upload completed forms and where to review redlines.

Best,
James
Attachment: Novum_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

From: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
To: James Holloway <james.holloway@novuminsights.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, Novum Legal <legal@novuminsights.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure private plan — procurement kickoff

James—great discussion this morning. Summary & next steps below (TL;DR + redlines):

Key confirmations: 
- SOC 2: we can share the 2026 Type II report via secure link; will provide within 24 hours to Novum Legal.
- DPA & KMS: our standard DPA supports integration with customer-managed keys when the private plan is deployed in the customer's subscription. We'll annotate the DPA to highlight the required KMS ARN and key rotation responsibilities.
- Data residency: we can agree to US-East only deployment for the private plan; will add a clause limiting storage/backup to US regions.
- Billing: Redwood can support seller-billed invoices and route to your vendor portal. We can accept net 45 for year-one onboarding cadence; commercial to confirm in the redlines.
- Marketplace publisher model: we support both seller-listed private offers and publisher-listed private plans. If Novum wants to be the publisher, we'll coordinate publisher onboarding and entitlement mapping; that path requires earlier co-sell coordination.

Attached: redlines_summary.docx (docx) — contains suggested commercial adjustments (net 45 first 3 months, migration credit of 1x monthly invoice if onboarding failures exceed threshold) plus the DPA annotation comments.

DocuSign/Redlines: I'll send a DocuSign powerform to Novum Legal for non-substantive countersigns and upload the tracked-redline paper to the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/0000000/deal/DEAL-987654.

Proposed timeline:
- 8/23: Novum Legal returns security questionnaire + any DPA counter-language.
- 8/24–8/25: Redwood legal posts tracked redlines and commercial summary.
- 8/26: Target signature (subject to legal review).

If Novum confirms publisher preference today, we'll send onboarding docs for publisher activation.

Thanks—I'll follow up with the SOC2 link and the DocuSign powerform shortly.

Best regards,
Aditya Rao
Senior GTM, Marketplace & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redlines_summary.docx (docx)
